why_trail.why: The comparison's own docstring already withdrew the unforgeability claim, so what is left of it is a location check that the lease already covers as ownership. The map says main() is its only production caller, which is why deleting it is a one-site change rather than a sweep.

The differential is the honest test here because a source scan for 'origin' cannot separate a decision from a display, while behaviour can: a decision reading the stamp cannot answer identically for the spine's own worktree and /nonexistent/some/other/tree.

The comparison could only ever say 'where am I', and the lease already says 'is this mine', so subtracting it costs no guard -- which is why the honest move was deletion rather than a seam that returns None forever.

The old paragraph's own call-site citation had been stale through at least two refactors, which is the argument for describing the mechanism and naming the test that pins it instead of pointing at a line.

The adversarial result turned on a measurement rather than an argument: the door chdirs into the spine's own worktree before every engine call, so for production's actual caller the comparison was already comparing a value with itself.
The map freshness test is what turned an invisible staleness into a named failure, which is the argument for regenerating rather than reasoning about whether counts moved.

The result had to carry the delete-the-verb-sets judgment and the one behaviour delta up front rather than buried, because those are the two places a reviewer could reasonably disagree with me and both are cheap to reverse.
